title: Duplicate Pending Charges & Failed Pro Upgrades
summary: Handling payment gateway webhook timeouts where customers see multiple $29.99 pending holds without receiving Pro plan access.
resolution_steps: Immediately escalate to a human Billing Specialist to manually provision temporary Pro access (unlocking Export) and void the duplicate $29.99 authorization holds.
Do NOT auto-respond; manual billing ledger intervention and entitlement override are required.
Treat any ticket involving duplicate charges combined with a bank dispute/chargeback threat or an imminent presentation deadline (< 4 hours) as CRITICAL urgency requiring ESCALATE_TO_HUMAN.

title: HTTP 500 Outage & Regional API Gateway Troubleshooting
summary: Procedure for diagnosing regional HTTP 500 errors and escalating active Enterprise incidents when the public status page is cached.
resolution_steps: Always run check_system_status for the customer's region because the public status page caches results for up to 30 minutes.

If internal telemetry confirms an active API Gateway HTTP 500 incident (such as INC-904 in ap-southeast-1) or multiple machines/browsers fail for an Enterprise tenant, classify urgency as CRITICAL and action as ESCALATE_TO_HUMAN.
Page On-Call SRE / Incident Response immediately and reassure the customer in their native language that engineers are actively mitigating the regional gateway issue ahead of their client demo.

title: macOS Dark Mode 'System Default' Sync Bug & Feature Requests
summary: Workaround for the minor macOS Desktop v2.4.1 'System Default' theme sync issue and product roadmap status for Scheduled Dark Mode.
resolution_steps: Known minor cosmetic bug in macOS Desktop v2.4.1: selecting 'System Default' appearance can stay stuck on Light theme until the user toggles macOS System Settings appearance once or updates to macOS Desktop v2.4.2.
Scheduled Dark Mode (auto-switching at a custom time) is currently on the Q3 Product Roadmap; log the customer's vote as a feature request.
Because a complete self-service workaround exists and there is no business blocker, classify urgency as LOW and next_action as AUTO_RESPOND.

title: Enterprise SAML 2.0 Certificate Rotation & SSO Signature Mismatch
summary: Procedure for updating SAML 2.0 X.509 certificates when an Enterprise tenant rotates their IdP signing key and cannot log in.
resolution_steps: Verify check_system_status to confirm there is no platform-wide outage; ERR_SAML_CERT_MISMATCH is a tenant-specific configuration issue.

Because a core authentication feature is broken for a paid user without a self-service workaround (password login disabled) and there is no < 4 hour demo/outage crisis, classify urgency as HIGH and next_action as ROUTE_TO_SPECIALIST.
Route to the Identity & Access Management (IAM) Specialist team to re-bind the tenant's SAML metadata XML.

title: Slack Webhook Payload Truncation (>50 Rows) & Chunking Flag
summary: Handling Slack webhook HTTP 413 payload size errors on large reports when customers have a working manual CSV export workaround.
resolution_steps: Because this is a partial functionality issue on an integration with a confirmed manual CSV export workaround, classify urgency as MEDIUM.
Enabling the backend multi-message webhook chunking flag requires backend configuration by a specialist; set next_action to ROUTE_TO_SPECIALIST (do not auto-respond).
Route to the Tier-2 Integrations Specialist team to enable `webhook_batch_chunking` for the workspace.
